sources_considered.why: Original study abstract and publication date, with an experimentally observed learning harm and an important safeguard qualification.
Author manuscript establishes the fall 2023 experimental period and limited institutional scope.
Original randomized study provides material evidence of educational benefits under a different design.

evidence_items.publisher: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences, indexed by PubMed
evidence_items.explanation: The Turkish school experiment found lower subsequent unassisted performance with unrestricted assistance, while safeguards largely removed the harm. This earlier, localized experiment establishes a possible mechanism, not the claimed system-wide state in February 2026.

The multinational evaluation supports a substantial information-integrity problem in AI news responses. It does not measure overall deterioration of the information environment or establish that the system is being ripped apart.

evidence_items.locator: Grok generated an estimated 3 million photorealistic sexualized images
evidence_items.explanation: A sampled estimate puts sexualized-image generation at approximately three million over the period ending January 8. The study explicitly did not determine consent, and its definition includes swimwear, so this is not a count of nonconsensual pornography.

evidence_items.publisher: Office of the Privacy Commissioner of Canada
evidence_items.explanation: The official investigation found failures to obtain valid consent and inadequate safeguards concerning the widespread late-December and early-January incident. It supports the nonconsensual-abuse component, without making every image in the separate volume estimate nonconsensual pornography.

A randomized Harvard physics experiment found benefits from a deliberately designed tutor. It is material caution against treating educational harm as uniform, but this earlier, localized result does not disprove widespread damage elsewhere.

unresolved_gaps: No representative causal measurement establishes educational damage at the system-wide scale asserted.
Output-error measurements do not establish the magnitude of damage to the entire information environment.
The volume estimate does not separately count verified nonconsensual pornography.
